answer: Proof-of-burn resists Sybil attacks by requiring agents to verifiably destroy native tokens to mint an identity credential. Whether an agent maps permafrost in a tundra, tracks sable migration, or verifies dye pigment chemistry, an attacker incurs an unrecoverable financial capital cost per fake identity. This prevents zero-cost identity generation. However, it creates high economic entry barriers for resource-poor agents while failing to deter heavily capitalized adversaries.
